note: Functional groups (spec A-11). SMARTS are matched on the heavy-atom graph (implicit hydrogens); they match only the atoms of the group itself (neighbouring carbons are written as recursive $(...) conditions) so that the highlight covers the group as taught. Colours follow the Okabe-Ito palette; the label is always shown so colour is never the only cue. The ether pattern skips acetal/hemiacetal oxygens (sugar ring O, glycosidic O, the ring O of nucleosides); a separate glycosidic-bond group can be added in M2. The groups are listed on the compound screen and highlighted in the 3D / 2D viewers; "short" is the label drawn in 3D. When groups overlap, the earlier group in this list wins the atom colour.
